content:
lee: noticed a billing/telemetry drift: console shows ~12% v2 traffic for a tenant but routing logs say 0% -> suspect a v2-badge attribution bug tied to quota-metering middleware. anyone?
anya: that's odd. which tenant?
lee: tenant org-id: ten_42-zeppelin. sample req: 02GAB7PQ1L2K3M4N5O6P7.
diego: quick tl;dr: quota-metrics runs before routing fallback. if v2 header present but routing rejects due to model-unavailable, we still attribute to v2 in the quota counter. console reads the quota counter for badge. routing uses final route for execution. mismatch.
riley: wow. so customers see v2 usage and get billed against v2 allotment even though they executed on v1? that could be a billing problem.
product-bot: [note] Billing-sensitivity: if confirmed, escalate to finance and CS.
lee: reproduced locally: request with X-Client-Version: v2 and model=v2-large but cluster returns 503 for that model; routing falls back to v1-small and it completes. quota counter incremented for v2.
anya: sequence diagram: ingress -> quota-check (increments tentative counter) -> route selection -> fallback. we need to ensure tentative counters aren't committed if fallback happens.
diego: options: A) delay quota increment until after final routing decision (safer, needs refactor), B) write compensating decrement when fallback occurs (fast hack), C) emit two tags (attempted_version vs routed_version) and make console badge read routed_version (less invasive).
riley: for billing, compensating decrements are risky if we miss some code paths. prefer C short-term, A long-term.
eng-sre-bot: [metric] spike detected: quota_attempted_v2 - quota_routed_v2 = 0.12 for ten_42-zeppelin over last 15m.
lee: I'll open an internal incident and notify finance/CS. we should also add an alert to the console dashboard for mismatches > 5% per-tenant.
anya: I'll prototype C: emit routed_version tag from routing-service and update console read path to prefer routed_version for badges and billing display. ETA: prototype in 2 days.
diego: I'll sketch the compensating decrement patch as fallback plan. tiny PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/quota/pulls/4240 (WIP). includes idempotent decrement keyed by request-id.
riley: for immediate mitigation, can we temporarily mark v2 badge as "attempted" and show a tooltip "may not reflect executed model" until we ship C?
lee: yes please. add copy saying "We show the version your client asked for. If we fell back due to capacity, the executed model may differ."
product-bot: [ui-change] suggested banner copy approved by product: "Version badge reflects client request; actual execution version available in request details."
eng-sre-bot: [deploy] routing-service change to emit routed_version on logs deployed to canary at 1761240005.
lee: canary checks look good. setting up dashboard alert: tenant-level version-attribution-delta > 0.05 triggers pager to eng-platform oncall.
anya: followup: add retroactive backfill task to fix historical billing attribution where delta > 10% last 24h. coordinate with finance.
diego: adding tests for counter idempotency.
riley: great. next steps checklist in channel: 1) quick UI tooltip (riley) 2) console read change to routed_version (anya) 3) compensating decrement PR review (diego) 4) billing backfill plan (lee + finance).
lee: assigning owners and pinging CS. thanks all. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread as single string of messages. No title per agents.md. All fields are strings or list of strings.
